rights_policy.permission_semantics: allowed_for_isolated_test is a narrow project risk decision for local, non-user-facing, non-redistributed evaluation of an officially published artifact. It is not a speaker-consent, personality-rights, distribution, commercial-use or production clearance.
rights_policy.model_repository_metadata: The pinned ONNX model card and repository metadata declare Apache-2.0, and the pinned GitHub source repository has a root Apache-2.0 LICENSE. Those facts establish a copyright-license basis for the published repository artifacts, but do not by themselves prove reference-speaker consent, voice/personality rights, training-data rights, or every downstream use.
rights_policy.production_rule: A preset or generated candidate is not production-cleared until a slot-specific rights record is approved and the no-public-figure/no-impersonation check passes.
rights_policy.reader_rule: MOSS-TTS-Nano-Reader at the pinned revision is NOASSERTION and must not be copied, packaged, or treated as a source of licensed voices.
rights_policy.child_voice_rule: A real child reference requires documented guardian and usage authorization; synthetic child-like candidates still require likeness and safety review.
rights_policy.celebrity_rule: Named public-figure imitation is excluded even from isolated testing. This excludes Trump and the Xiaoyu/zh_11.wav preset because the pinned official demo metadata labels the latter 杨幂 - 与自己同行.
rights_policy.unknown_rule: Any missing or ambiguous source, speaker identity, consent, likeness, redistribution or commercial-use evidence is unresolved and therefore no-go for distribution, commercial product use and the production 24-slot pack.

official_inventory_comparison.decision: The ONNX manifest is the contract input for ONNX built-ins; no name-only cross-runtime substitution is allowed. Every runtime must expose a model-fingerprinted inventory, and a mismatch blocks automatic preset migration.
